zach: Quick sync — can owners confirm for INC-2026-045 RCA actions? Pulled from the doc below, please reply with 'I own A# — ETA' or note blockers. I’ll collate.

```
- A1: Add retry/backoff in request router (owner: TBD) — reduces transient 502s (due: TBD)
- A2: Add KV cache eviction metric + alert (owner: TBD) — investigate eviction spikes (due: TBD)
- A3: Harden model fallback logic for OOMs (owner: TBD) — ensure graceful degrade (due: TBD)
- A4: Finalize postmortem writeup + customer note (owner: TBD) (due: TBD)
```

If you take one, just reply with the item and ETA. Ping if blocked. Thanks.

marie: Ill take A1. Target Thu 2026-03-26. Need to coordinate with eng-runtime on the deploy window. :white_check_mark:

aaron: Assign A3 to me. ETA Mon 2026-03-30. There's an open PR touching fallback paths: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/1204 — needs a quick review from @dan before merge.

priya: @aaron I can review #1204 today. For A2 I can add the eviction metric but it requires a small schema change in telemetry pipeline — will open PR for that (https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/563). Might need one-day coord with infra.

dan: I'll review #1204 this afternoon. note: infra deploy freeze Wed-Fri next week; if we need the change in that window we'll have to request an exception.

emma: For the customer-facing note, I'll draft a one-pager once the postmortem is final. If writeup is ready by Mon I can publish Tue. cc @support

incident-bot: Reminder: RCA draft deadline in 72 hours — 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC. Please update the doc with owners/dates to avoid reminders.

zach: thanks — updated the doc with A1/A3/A2 tentative owners + ETAs. @marie @aaron @priya please add short blockers into the doc (one line) so I can escalate if needed. Ill ping infra about freeze exception if the timeline slips. :thumbsup:
